blog.title: TipPool: nightly tip-outs without the math
blog.description: Split the night's tips by hours worked, with penny-exact payouts and a printable tip-out sheet.

body.text: Tip-out math happens at closing time, when everyone is tired and the manager still has a restaurant to close. TipPool exists so splitting the night's tips takes a minute and the numbers always add up.

Enter the cash and card tips and your tip-out percentage for support staff. Add everyone on shift, mark them tipped or support, and set their hours. TipPool splits the pools by hours worked, rounds everything to the cent, and shows each person's share. Print a tip-out sheet for the night or save it to reload later.
